analyst.summary: Lumax Auto Technologies supplies components to two-wheeler and passenger-vehicle makers and has just completed a merger bringing an auto-interiors business (IAC India) fully into the company, alongside a strategic push into EV and clean-mobility components (40% of its stated new order book). The very high growth numbers in the standard data partly reflect this merger consolidating revenue into the base rather than pure like-for-like business growth, so they should be read with that caveat. The company's own medium-term target is a more modest, still healthy 20% annual growth over the next several years. We rate it a Hold: a real strategic pivot toward EV-related components, but recent growth numbers need a merger-adjusted read and leverage is on the higher side for this batch.
